quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #6
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: You are stopped behind other vehicles at a stop sign. After the vehicles ahead pass through and there is no oncoming traffic, you:

options.text: May proceed through without stopping again.
Must stop at the stop sign or stop line before proceeding.
May slowly roll past the stop sign.
May follow the vehicle ahead without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must stop at the stop sign or stop line before proceeding.
questions.explanation: You must always come to a complete stop at the stop sign and check for traffic before proceeding. Do not skip this step just because other vehicles are moving.

questions.question: Your chances of being killed are ____ times greater if you are thrown from your car in an accident.
questions.explanation: Wearing your seat belt greatly reduces your risk of injury or death. If you are thrown from your car during a crash, your chances of dying are 25 times higher.

questions.question: Roads freeze quickly when they are:
questions.explanation: Shaded areas freeze faster than sunny areas. Be extra careful on roads in shade from trees or buildings during cold weather. These spots also take longer to dry.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: Which statement is true?

options.text: Signal at least 100 feet before changing lanes. Make sure no traffic is coming.
Use your mirrors and look over your left shoulder to check your blind spot when passing left.
When passing, wait until you see both headlights of the passed car in your rearview mirror before returning to your lane.

questions.explanation: When passing: Signal 100 feet ahead. Check mirrors and look over your shoulder for blind spots. Do not return to your lane until you see both headlights of the passed car in your rearview mirror.

questions.question: When changing lanes, wait for a minimum ____ gap in traffic.
questions.explanation: Find a four- or five-second gap in the lane you want to enter. Signal, check your mirrors and blind spot, adjust your speed, and move into the lane. Cancel your signal when done.

questions.question: A flashing red light means:

options.text: The same as a stop sign.
You do not have to stop completely.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same as a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Come to a complete stop, yield to traffic and pedestrians, and proceed only when safe.

questions.question: When a curb is painted ____, it indicates a loading zone or another parking restriction.
questions.explanation: A yellow curb means there is a loading zone or other parking restriction in that area.

questions.question: On a two-lane road without bike lanes, how do you safely pass a bicycle?

options.text: Slow down and wait for no oncoming traffic. Pass while leaving the bicycle plenty of space.
Continue driving straight. The bicycle must get out of your way.
Do not pass until you reach a traffic signal or stop sign.
Honk to let the cyclist know you are passing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and wait for no oncoming traffic. Pass while leaving the bicycle plenty of space.
questions.explanation: Pass a bicycle like any other vehicle. Leave at least 3 feet on regular roads or 5 feet on faster roads. Honking can scare the cyclist.

questions.question: At a light rail intersection, always:

options.text: Look both ways before crossing tracks.
Pay attention and obey all traffic signals.
Share the road with pedestrians and bicyclists.

questions.explanation: Never drive around lowered crossing gates. Look both ways before crossing train tracks. Obey all signs and traffic signals. Trains, bicyclists, and pedestrians share the road.

questions.question: A bicyclist who doesn't obey traffic laws:

options.text: Is allowed to break traffic laws.
Will always get a warning from police.
Will have their bike taken away.

questions.explanation: Bicyclists have the same rights and responsibilities as drivers. Both can be ticketed for breaking traffic laws.

questions.question: The space you need to cross traffic depends on:

options.text: Road conditions, weather, and oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road conditions, weather, and oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: The space you need to cross traffic depends on road conditions, weather, and oncoming traffic.

questions.question: Is it legal to cross a double solid yellow centerline to pass?

options.text: If there is no oncoming traffic.
If the car ahead is going under the speed limit.

questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no passing. You cannot cross them unless turning into a driveway or business entrance.

questions.question: If a tire blows out while you are driving, you should:

options.text: Keep the wheel straight and slow down by taking your foot off the gas.
Keep your speed and steer straight.
Swerve back and forth to warn cars behind you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep the wheel straight and slow down by taking your foot off the gas.
questions.explanation: If a tire blows out, hold the wheel tight and go straight. Ease off the gas and don't brake until you have control. Then brake gently and pull off the road safely.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is ahead. The road will split into two one-way lanes with a divider. Stay to the right.

questions.question: Driving while distracted:

options.text: Usually makes drivers react slowly to hazards.
Is only dangerous for young drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Usually makes drivers react slowly to hazards.
questions.explanation: Distractions slow down your reaction time to traffic and road hazards. Distracted driving is never safe.

questions.question: When driving where children are playing, expect them to:

options.text: Know when it is safe to cross the street.
Stop at the curb before crossing.
Run in front of you without looking.
Not cross unless with an adult.

questions.correctAnswerText: Run in front of you without looking.
questions.explanation: Always slow down and be careful around children. They may not understand danger and could run into the street without looking.

questions.question: When driving uphill behind a heavy truck, you should know:

options.text: The truck may be going slower than the speed limit.
You may not be able to pass safely.
You may not be able to pass legally.

questions.explanation: Large trucks often go slower than the speed limit on hills. You may not be able to pass safely or legally on hills where you can't see ahead.

questions.question: A person walking with a white cane or guide dog is likely:
questions.explanation: A white cane or guide dog means a blind person. Always give them the right-of-way.

questions.question: You may pass another vehicle:

options.text: In a curve or on a hill because few cars are coming.
If your lane has a solid yellow line and the other side is clear.

questions.explanation: Never pass on hills or curves where you can't see oncoming traffic. Never pass by driving on the shoulder. Never pass over a solid yellow line.

questions.question: Drivers who eat and drink while driving:

options.text: Are better drivers because they are not hungry.

questions.explanation: Eating, drinking, or smoking while driving is dangerous. These actions take your hands off the wheel and your eyes off the road. Drivers who do these things have trouble staying in their lanes and controlling their vehicles.

questions.question: Distracted driving is:

options.text: No less safe than driving under any other conditions.

questions.explanation: Distracted driving is extremely risky. It puts you, your passengers, pedestrians, bicyclists, and other drivers in danger. Paying attention to driving helps prevent crashes.

questions.question: You are driving at night and another vehicle is coming toward you. Your headlights:

options.text: Should be off. Use your parking lights.
May be on high or low beam.

questions.explanation: Do not use high beam headlights when approaching or following another vehicle at night. Switch to low beam to keep everyone safe.

questions.question: How do you check your blind spots?

options.text: By looking in your side mirrors.
By turning your head and looking over your shoulders.
By looking in your rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: By turning your head and looking over your shoulders.
questions.explanation: Blind spots are areas you cannot see in your mirrors. Check them by turning your head and looking over your shoulders.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you drive past this sign, you are going the wrong way. You risk a head-on collision. Carefully turn around.

questions.question: When entering a street from a driveway, you:

options.text: Must drive slowly to allow approaching vehicles and pedestrians time to get out of your way.
Must honk your horn so approaching vehicles and pedestrians know to give you room.
Must stop and proceed only when there are no pedestrians or vehicles approaching.
Can disregard any pedestrians if there is no sidewalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must stop and proceed only when there are no pedestrians or vehicles approaching.
questions.explanation: Always stop before entering the roadway from a driveway. Yield to any approaching vehicles or pedestrians crossing. Stop before crossing the sidewalk area. Not stopping is against the law.

questions.question: You may pass another vehicle if the line dividing your lane from the lane you wish to enter is a ____ line.
questions.explanation: White lines separate lanes going in the same direction. You may cross broken white lines to pass if the passing lane is clear.

questions.question: If you leave your vehicle unattended, you must:

options.text: Lock the ignition and remove the key.

questions.explanation: When you leave your vehicle unattended, you must turn off the engine, lock the ignition, remove the key, and set the parking brake.

questions.question: When traffic lights are horizontal instead of vertical, the red light is:
questions.explanation: Some traffic lights are horizontal instead of vertical. On these signals, red is on the left, yellow is in the middle, and green is on the right.

questions.question: What does an orange-colored sign indicate?

options.text: The start of a no passing zone.

questions.explanation: Orange signs show construction, maintenance, and emergency work. They have black symbols on them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings tell drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming.

questions.question: When can a driver legally pass on the right side of another vehicle?

options.text: If the vehicle is turning left and there is a passing lane available.
Even if it means driving off the pavement.

questions.correctAnswerText: If the vehicle is turning left and there is a passing lane available.
questions.explanation: You may pass on the right if there is a passing lane and the car ahead is turning left or waiting to turn left. You can also pass on the right on roads with two or more lanes in the same direction. Never drive off the road to pass another vehicle.

questions.question: In a city, how many blocks ahead should you look?
questions.explanation: Looking ahead helps you spot hazards early. In the city, look at least two blocks ahead of your vehicle.

questions.question: Your power steering stops working while you drive. What should you do?

options.text: Honk your horn and turn off the ignition.
Turn on your hazard lights and brace yourself.
Steer firmly, slow down, drive to a safe area, and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steer firmly, slow down, drive to a safe area, and stop.
questions.explanation: Without power steering, you need more force to turn the wheel. Reduce your speed and move to a safe area off the road before stopping.

questions.question: What must a driver do at a flashing red traffic signal?
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Yield to traffic and pedestrians, then go only when it is safe. At railroad crossings, a flashing red light means a train is coming. Wait until the lights stop flashing before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What should a driver do before taking a non-prescription drug and driving?

options.text: Read the label on the drug before driving.
Continue to drive regardless of warning labels.

questions.correctAnswerText: Read the label on the drug before driving.
questions.explanation: Over-the-counter medicines, including cold and allergy remedies, can affect your driving. Always check the label for warnings. Ask your doctor or pharmacist if you are unsure about driving while taking any medication.

questions.question: At a four-way stop, who has the right-of-way?

options.text: One driver should continue without stopping.
One driver should wave the others ahead.

questions.explanation: At four-way stops, all vehicles must stop. The first vehicle to reach the intersection goes first. If two vehicles arrive at the same time, the driver on the right goes first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: When can you drive across a dashed white line?

options.text: When it is safe to change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it is safe to change lanes.
questions.explanation: Dashed white lines separate lanes going in the same direction. You may cross a dashed line to change lanes if it is safe to do so.
